title: Kaho Naa... Pyaar Hai
desc: After the untimely death of her lover, Sonia sinks into depression. She soon moves abroad for a fresh start, unaware of the twisted fate that awaits her.

title: Coolie No. 1
desc: A matchmaker sets out to teach Hoshiyar Chand a lesson while hilarity ensues when he asks Raju, a coolie, to pretend to be a millionaire.

title: Nigahen
desc: A Snake Charmer Is In Search Of A Priceless Diamond Which Will Bestow Him With Immense Power. However, He Discovers That His Only Hope Of Locating The Diamond Is Rajiv And Rajni's Daughter Neelam.

title: Sapoot
desc: Devastated after the ruthless murder of their father, two brothers, Raj and Prem, set out to exact revenge on the gangster responsible for his death.

title: Indian
desc: Police officer Raj Azad arrests terrorist Wasim Khan and prepares to interrogate him. However, his father-in-law mysteriously dies, after which he is blamed for his death and goes on the run.
